item.title: U Sports sprinters storm to world championship standard in Winnipeg
item.description: Canadian rising stars Gabrielle Cole and Tyrell Davis headlined the opening night of the 2026 U Sports Championships The post U Sports sprinters storm to world championship standard in Winnipeg appeared first on Canadian Running Magazine.

item.title: USATF calls on World Athletics to determine half-marathon outcome
item.description: "While many have called on us to simply dismiss the procedures, we had serious concerns about the long-term precedent that it could set," said USATF CEO Max Siegel on not awarding the win and spots to the misdirected runners The post USATF calls on World Athletics to determine half-marathon outcome appeared first on Canadian Running Magazine.

item.title: Olympic 100m medallist Fred Kerley handed two-year whereabouts ban
item.description: Kerley promised a world record the next time he ran the 100m. Now, a two-year ban will keep him off the track The post Olympic 100m medallist Fred Kerley handed two-year whereabouts ban appeared first on Canadian Running Magazine.

item.title: Jacob Kiplimo recoups world half-marathon record in Lisbon
item.description: Kiplimo clocked 57:20 at the Lisbon Half Marathon, just months after a faster time of his was ruled ineligible The post Jacob Kiplimo recoups world half-marathon record in Lisbon appeared first on Canadian Running Magazine.

item.title: Canadian women shine at Transgrancanaria ultras
item.description: Kelsey Hogan and Stephanie Case both went top-7 in the 126K, while Geneviève Asselin-Demers finished just off the podium in the 80K The post Canadian women shine at Transgrancanaria ultras appeared first on Canadian Running Magazine.

item.title: Did fan interference cost this runner the L.A. Marathon win?
item.description: Nathan Martin might have just had the craziest marathon comeback we’ve ever seen, all thanks to a random spectator The post Did fan interference cost this runner the L.A. Marathon win? appeared first on Canadian Running Magazine.

item.title: 102-year-old man wins four events at Canadian Masters Championships
